tagline: Log completed Todoist tasks to Google Sheets and turn sheet rows into tasks
metaTitle: Todoist + Google Sheets Integration: Completed Task Log
metaDescription: Log completed Todoist tasks to Google Sheets and get weekly productivity summaries. GAIA creates tasks from rows. See the setup steps.
keywords: export todoist tasks to google sheets
intro:
Todoist knows what you finished, but proving it means screenshots or manual logs. Managers ask for weekly summaries, freelancers need billable-task records, and teams want cycle-time data, all locked inside the task list.

GAIA pipes Todoist into Google Sheets automatically. Completed tasks append to a log sheet with project, labels, dates, and priority fields, ready for pivot tables. The reverse works too: rows added to a sheet, new leads, content ideas, bug reports, become tasks with fields mapped to titles, projects, and due dates.

The result is a personal analytics layer on top of the task list plus a bulk-entry path for work captured anywhere else. Your tasks stay the place work happens, and Sheets becomes the place work gets measured.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Google Sheets to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with both accounts. Choose which projects log to the spreadsheet and which tabs create tasks.
Match task fields like project, labels, priority, and due date to sheet columns. GAIA remembers the mapping for every future sync.

howItWorks.step: GAIA logs completions and creates tasks
howItWorks.description: Finished tasks append to the log on their own while new sheet rows arrive as tasks. Both directions run without babysitting.

faqs.question: Can GAIA automatically log my completed Todoist tasks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Connect your account and pick a log spreadsheet. Every completed task appends a row with project, labels, dates, and priority, so your history builds itself.

faqs.question: Which task fields appear in the sheet?
faqs.answer: Task title, project, section, labels, priority, due date, creation date, and completion timestamp. You choose the column order once and GAIA keeps it for every row.

faqs.question: Can new rows in a sheet become tasks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Map columns to task fields and each new row creates a task in the project you chose, with priority and due date set from the sheet values.

faqs.question: Can I log only certain projects and not everything?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select exactly which projects feed the log. Personal tasks stay private while work projects sync for reporting.

faqs.question: Does GAIA handle recurring tasks in the log?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each completion of a recurring task logs its own row with its own dates, so streaks and frequency analysis stay accurate.
